nom: Alba Botanica Acnedote Maximum Strength Face & Body Scrub for Acne Treatment

segments.oily: The reviewer with an oily T-zone reports it targets blackheads and hormonal acne there without drying her skin out, and layers well with a moisturizer afterward.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including ones with hormonal acne, mostly report clear skin without irritation, though one reviewer describes a severe allergic-type reaction — a red, burning, swollen face, neck, and chest — that she ties to a recent reformulation.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry, peeling, or seborrheic skin report soft, baby-smooth results with no irritation or added dryness, even with regular use.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin calls this the only scrub that strikes the right balance for her, saying rougher scrubs over-dry her skin while gentler ones don't clear her acne, and that other scrubs make her break out more than this one does.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 80s report no irritation or dryness with daily to regular use, with the eldest crediting consistent use for smooth, healthy-looking skin without dark spots or heavy wrinkling.

concerns.aging: The material here is thin: one 80-year-old reviewer credits years of daily use with smooth, healthy-looking skin without dark spots or heavy wrinkling, though this reflects one person's account rather than a broad pattern.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers across dry, sensitive, and mature skin consistently report it doesn't dry their skin out despite being an exfoliant, several specifically noting it left skin softer rather than stripped.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no burning or irritation, including several with sensitive skin, but one describes a severe reaction — a red, itchy, burning face, neck, and chest — that she attributes to a recent reformulation rather than the product she'd used safely before.
concerns.spots: The only comment on discoloration comes from one long-term user in her 80s who reports no dark spots, though she frames this as a general description of her skin rather than a specific before-and-after result.
concerns.blemishes: This is the concern reviewers report most consistently and positively: many describe noticeably fewer breakouts, faster-fading blackheads and zits, and clearer skin within days to weeks, with several specifically saying other scrubs made them break out more than this one does.

aspects.libelle: Recent packaging change from yellow to white tube caused confusion
Some bottles arrive burst or leaking
Gritty texture that exfoliates without feeling harsh
Large bottle lasts a very long time

extraits.titre: Why is this suddenly making me have a serious allergic reaction?
extraits.texte: The stuff in a yellow tube never bothered me! I am sitting here writing this angry review because I currently have a red, puffy, itchy, burning face, neck, ears, and chest! Like I got a REALLY bad sunburn (I didn't! It was this scrub!) 🤬 Not sure if alba decided to change their recipe or what, but I USED TO love this stuff. Smelled great, worked great, was great. Not anymore. Doesn't smell as good as the yellow tube (what i got was in an all-white tube but seems to be the same product?) and definitely didn't leave my skin feeling refreshed! Quite the opposite, I'd say... 😒 Not sure if the white tube is a different formula, but I wont be buying this anymore. Bummer. Painful and annoying bummer.

extraits.titre: Great For Body; Gentle For Face
extraits.texte: The Alba Botanica Acne-dote face & body scrub has a very subtle smell thanks to the willow bark extract! If using on your face, a little definitely goes a long way. The scrub is abrasive enough so you know it is exfoliating your skin but gentle enough that it doesn't feel like it's taking a layer off. It's oil free which is great for us who have oily skin which leads to annoying blackheads for me. I intentionally focused on my oily t-zone, especially while currently dealing with hormonal acne. My face felt clean, after toning there wasn't much residue (dirt) left after cleansing with the product & my moisturizer soaked into my skin better than it did prior to using the scrub. Yessss to not drying my skin out after using & having 100% vegetarian ingredients! Can't wait to use on the rest of my body.

This is one the most consistent product for my sensitive, peely, dry, seborrheic face. Baby soft skin and no irritation. Light exfoliation texture really helps scrub away the sleepiness and relaxing for bed time. Great value!

extraits.titre: The only face scrub that works for me
extraits.texte: I have tried so many different face scrubs over the years. I have combination skin and most scrubs are either too rough and dry out my skin too much, or they are too gentle and don't really clean that deeply, only at the surface level, (which doesn't really help with acne or clogged pores). This scrub seems to be the perfect balance, it's not too rough. It's the only thing that clears up my acne and keeps my skin clean, clear consistently. Other scrubs, unfortunately cause me to break out even more. Sure, other scrubs may be less expensive, but I am willing to pay a little more for this scrub, because it works for me and shows long term results with consistent use.

After a years long search for a working acne scrub, I came across the Alba products. At first I was a little skeptical about the 100% vegetarian ingredients, thinking that it wouldn't work, but boy was I wrong! I tried it out as soon as it arrived, and was surprised when it didn't burn my face like other acne products do. The small particles in the scrub make for a very gentle, soothing cleaning! Unlike other scrubs with large, rough particles that scratch my face. I used only a small amount, which was enough to cover my entire face, and rubbed it in for about a minute, and let it sit for five minutes before rinsing. Something that I really liked was that it didn't hurt like crazy when a little got in my eye, and it was rather easy to clean out. While I was rinsing it just felt like my face was cleaner, and I could tell that my pores were open. After when my face was dry, it didn't look oily at all like other scrubs make it! It also didn't dry my skin out anymore than it already is, but made it softer than I can ever remember! After using it twice a day for only four days I am already noticing a huge difference in my acne! The giant zits on my cheeks and chin are fading faster than ever, and almost all of the little blackheads on my forehead are gone! Even the deep blackheads on my nose that have been there for years are getting a little better! I am absolutely amazed at how well this scrub has worked with my acne compared to other products. Proactiv didn't work half this goo

I have been using this scrub for over a year 1x/day. I feel my skin is to fragile, I’m 80, to use more than that. I do use an electric scrub brush. I have used other grit, sand and stone scrubs for 15-20 yrs. I just call them that. My skin is always clean. No irritation. Easy to use and smells ok. People have a hard time guessing my age because my skin has no dark spots, is smooth, looks healthy and I’m not heavily wrinkled. I can pass for 70. I know that’s not young but I’ll take it. I highly recommended this product. Rub it on ur wet face, scrub with the brush, splash water on your face to clean. I don’t use a wash cloth and I gently pat my face dry.
I’m Asian with sensitive skin and hormonal acne. This product is really good for keeping my skin clear without harsh and unnecessary ingredients.
